# This directory holds the compiled AutoIt patch script (postilion_patch.exe).
# The .exe is generated by compiling scripts/autoit/postilion_patch.au3
# using the compile_autoit.ps1 helper script.
#
# To compile:
#   cd scripts\autoit
#   .\compile_autoit.ps1 -Au3Source postilion_patch.au3 -OutputExe postilion_patch.exe
#   Copy-Item postilion_patch.exe ..\..\roles\postilion_patches\files\
